story-005.title: The Saintess Failed Her Exam
story-005.opening: The kingdom's chosen saintess cannot pass basic spellcraft. As her reluctant tutor, you discover her miracles obey a language the academy forbids anyone to teach.

story-027.title: The Last Train Home with You
story-027.opening: Two strangers share the last train after overtime. A lost umbrella starts a nightly ritual, until one of them announces a transfer that will end the route.

story-040.title: The Midnight Lost and Found
story-040.opening: Your new night job returns objects people cannot remember losing. A forgotten wedding ring arrives with tomorrow's date and a warning addressed to you.

story-024.title: We Stole the Prophecy
story-024.opening: Two thieves steal a sealed prophecy to cancel their deaths. The scroll is blank, and every lie they tell begins becoming the kingdom's new history.

story-030.title: We Only Meet When It Rains
story-030.opening: A photographer and a restoration artist keep sheltering at the same closed kiosk. One plans to leave the city before summer, making every forecast feel like a promise.

story-022.title: My Save Point Is a Tea Shop
story-022.opening: Every fatal quest returns you to the same tea shop at dawn. Its owner remembers every loop, but each cup she serves removes one possible future.

story-021.title: The Princess Hired the Wrong Knight
story-021.opening: A mistaken identity lands a stage swordswoman a royal escort job. The princess recognizes the fraud—and hires her anyway for a journey no real knight would accept.

story-023.title: The Kingdom in My Suitcase
story-023.opening: An abandoned suitcase contains a living miniature kingdom. Its people name you their guardian, while a full-sized army begins searching the city for its missing border.

story-039.title: Someone Is Editing My Memories
story-039.opening: You begin recording each day after finding photographs of a life you never lived. Every morning the evidence improves—and one trusted friend remembers the edits.

sg-004.title: The Tale of Zhuge Liang
sg-004.opening: A hermit in a thatched cottage plans the whole realm on a map. Step out of the mountains and find out whether one mind can bend the age.

story-016.title: The Hero Left Me His Debt
story-016.opening: The hero dies with your name on his will. You inherit no sword or kingdom, only a debt ledger—and creditors who claim his final quest was never finished.

story-049.title: The Mountain Refused My Ascension
story-049.opening: At the summit of immortality, the mountain sends you back to its lowest village. To ascend, you must resolve a promise your previous life made to the land itself.

story-007.title: The Academy Beneath the Lake
story-007.opening: When the lake freezes, a staircase appears beneath the ice. The submerged academy offers you a place—provided you return a memory each time you surface.

story-043.title: Do Not Answer the Second Bell
story-043.opening: A night caretaker follows one rule: ignore the second bell. When it rings in a missing friend's voice, silence becomes harder than entering the sealed tower.

story-041.title: My Shadow Signed the Contract
story-041.opening: An archivist discovers her shadow has sold a year of her life. To reclaim it, she must audit a supernatural contract whose witnesses are disappearing one by one.

story-011.title: The Girl Who Steals Tomorrow
story-011.opening: She can borrow one day from the future, but someone else must lose it. When she saves your life, you inherit the debt collectors who stand outside time.

sg-008.title: The Tale of Zhao Yun
sg-008.opening: One lone rider and a child in his arms against a whole army. Ride beside the steadiest spear of the age and learn what courage looks like when no one is watching.

story-002.title: Class Zero
story-002.opening: Assigned to a class for unranked adults, a failed prodigy discovers that each classmate can break a different rule of magic—and someone has scheduled their disappearance.

story-047.title: The Sword Sleeps in the Teahouse
story-047.opening: A retired swordsman serves tea beside a blade that has slept for ten years. When it begins to hum, an ordinary guest asks for the one story he swore never to tell.

story-037.title: Room 404 Has a Guest
story-037.opening: Your hotel has no fourth floor, yet a guest checks into Room 404 every Thursday. Tonight the register lists your name as the next person to stay.

story-012.title: Our Club Ends the World
story-012.opening: The university's smallest club studies harmless urban legends. Each solved mystery brings the same impossible date closer: the day your club photo ends the world.

story-045.title: The Angel on the Wanted Poster
story-045.opening: A bounty hunter tracks an angel accused of stealing prayers. Capturing her is easy; deciding who should receive the stolen wishes may cost the kingdom its peace.

story-004.title: The Last Seat at Eclipse Academy
story-004.opening: A late admission letter arrives during an eclipse. Your scholarship belongs to a student who never existed, and every teacher remembers a different version of you.

story-046.title: The Immortal Who Lost His Name
story-046.opening: A nameless immortal wakes in your mountain clinic. Every recovered memory restores a power—and alerts an old enemy who believes forgetting was his only mercy.

sg-003.title: The Tale of Guan Yu
sg-003.opening: Loyalty is easy to swear and hard to keep. Follow the red-faced general across five passes and discover what he will not trade for any price.

story-019.title: The Dungeon Has a New Landlord
story-019.opening: A broken inheritance spell makes you owner of a bankrupt dungeon. To keep its monsters housed, you must turn deadly traps into a business adventurers will return to.

story-001.title: The Forbidden Book Chose Me
story-001.opening: A forbidden grimoire offers an expelled student one final entrance exam: uncover who erased his magic before the academy erases him.

story-025.title: The Sword Refuses a Hero
story-025.opening: The sacred sword rejects every champion and speaks only to its cleaner. It claims the next hero will end the world—and asks you to break it before the coronation.

story-033.title: My Fake Date Remembers Everything
story-033.opening: You hire a friend to pose as your partner for a family reunion. Her effortless knowledge of your smallest habits makes the rehearsed romance increasingly hard to dismiss.

sg-006.title: The Tale of Lü Bu
sg-006.opening: The strongest warrior alive trusts no one and is trusted by no one. Ride with him and decide whether a man like that can ever choose a side.

story-015.title: Please Hide My Halo
story-015.opening: An angel enrolls in a human ability academy to investigate a missing prayer. Her halo keeps revealing her secrets, and the quiet student beside her can see every one.

story-038.title: The Saint in the Mirror
story-038.opening: A museum restorer uncovers a saint who moves only in reflections. She offers to cure a dying city, provided you find the person standing where her reflection should be.

story-050.title: A Fox Spirit Owes Me a Favor
story-050.opening: You rescue a wounded fox and ask for nothing. Years later, a charming fox spirit arrives to repay the favor just as your town prepares to banish every spirit within its walls.

story-013.title: The Villain Teaches Ethics
story-013.opening: A retired villain becomes your professor. His final assignment asks you to defend a person the kingdom has already condemned—and the evidence points to your classmates.

story-008.title: My Familiar Is the Final Boss
story-008.opening: Your summoning exam produces a tiny creature with the seal of the world's destroyer. Raising it might prevent the prophecy—or teach it exactly how to fulfill it.

story-026.title: My Roommate Writes Our Ending
story-026.opening: Your novelist roommate's unpublished scenes keep coming true. When her next chapter ends with your farewell, you must decide whether to read ahead or change the story together.

story-009.title: Everyone Forgot the Top Student
story-009.opening: A portrait in the honors hall changes every night. You alone remember its original subject, and your investigation makes your own name begin to vanish.

sg-005.title: The Tale of Zhou Yu
sg-005.opening: Brilliant, proud, and under the gaze of a rival who sees through him. Stand beside the young admiral of Wu as the river fills with fire.

sg-002.title: The Tale of Cao Cao
sg-002.opening: He is a hero in peacetime and a schemer in chaos. Serve beside the most ambitious man of the age and learn what it takes to hold an empire together.

story-031.title: A Love Letter Sent Too Late
story-031.opening: A delayed letter arrives on the day you return home. Its sender now works at the local post office—and insists the letter was never meant to be delivered.

story-032.title: The Bookshop Between Our Lives
story-032.opening: A secondhand book contains notes from a stranger whose days mirror yours. Following the margins leads you to a bookshop scheduled to close before your stories can meet.

story-042.title: The Funeral Photographer
story-042.opening: A funeral photographer develops a portrait of someone still alive. Saving the stranger exposes a business that has been selling perfectly predicted deaths.

story-010.title: The Hero Course Reject
story-010.opening: Rejected from the hero program, you join the cleanup unit. Every ruined battlefield reveals a lie about the celebrated victories—and the next rescue may make you a traitor.

story-036.title: The City That Forgot the Sun
story-036.opening: In a city where dawn is a myth, an apprentice lamplighter finds a living sunbeam. Carrying it home reveals who profits from the endless night.

story-035.title: Your Name on My Coffee Cup
story-035.opening: A barista keeps writing the wrong name on your cup. When the intended customer finally appears, a harmless mix-up opens the door to a shared neighborhood dream.

story-028.title: My Rival Runs the Flower Shop
story-028.opening: Your fiercest design-school rival now owns the flower shop beside your studio. A joint wedding commission forces you to confront the apology neither of you ever sent.

story-014.title: A Duel Before Graduation
story-014.opening: Two former partners must duel for the only royal appointment. On the eve of graduation, one asks you to investigate why the academy needs the loser to disappear.

story-003.title: My Rival Knows My Future
story-003.opening: Your academy rival keeps saving you from disasters that have not happened. To stop a foretold duel, you must learn which future she is trying to protect.

sg-001.title: The Tale of Liu Bei
sg-001.opening: A penniless heir of the Han court has only a name and a promise. Win people to his side one by one, and decide what mercy is worth in a war.

story-048.title: Letters to the Moon Palace
story-048.opening: A village courier receives letters addressed to the moon. Delivering the first brings an answer from an exiled celestial who has been waiting for a human reply.

story-006.title: A Scholarship from the Demon King
story-006.opening: An anonymous patron pays your tuition in exchange for monthly reports. The patron is the demon king, and your first assignment is to keep the future hero alive.

story-020.title: A Healer for the Enemy
story-020.opening: Captured beyond the front line, you are ordered to save an enemy commander. His wounds carry the signature of your own kingdom's forbidden healing magic.

story-017.title: The Last Inn Before the Abyss
story-017.opening: You inherit an inn at the edge of a bottomless rift. Every guest is fleeing a different ending, and tonight one room has been booked by the abyss itself.

story-044.title: The Museum of Unlived Lives
story-044.opening: A private museum displays the lives its visitors almost chose. Your exhibit is empty, and the curator insists someone else is still living every future you abandoned.

sg-007.title: The Tale of Diaochan
sg-007.opening: She was given a role in a plot far bigger than herself. Walk the palace corridors with her and see where a chosen path turns into her own.

story-034.title: After the Encore
story-034.opening: A sound engineer helps a singer rebuild her career after their band's breakup. One unfinished song draws them back together, but neither agrees on how it should end.

story-018.title: I Deliver Letters to Dragons
story-018.opening: The mountain post hires you for a route no rider survives. Your first letter is addressed to a dragon thought dead, and its reply could restart a forgotten war.

story-029.title: The Girl on the Other Balcony
story-029.opening: You exchange plant-care notes with the woman across the courtyard. When demolition notices arrive, finding a way to meet becomes a race to save the place that connected you.

sgc-001.title: Liu Bei
sgc-001.opening: Liu Bei of the Three Kingdoms. A penniless heir of the Han court has only a name and a promise. Win people to his side one by one, and decide what mercy is worth in a war.

sgc-002.title: Cao Cao
sgc-002.opening: Cao Cao of the Three Kingdoms. He is a hero in peacetime and a schemer in chaos. Serve beside the most ambitious man of the age and learn what it takes to hold an empire together.

sgc-003.title: Guan Yu
sgc-003.opening: Guan Yu of the Three Kingdoms. Loyalty is easy to swear and hard to keep. Follow the red-faced general across five passes and discover what he will not trade for any price.

sgc-004.title: Zhuge Liang
sgc-004.opening: Zhuge Liang of the Three Kingdoms. A hermit in a thatched cottage plans the whole realm on a map. Step out of the mountains and find out whether one mind can bend the age.

sgc-005.title: Zhou Yu
sgc-005.opening: Zhou Yu of the Three Kingdoms. Brilliant, proud, and under the gaze of a rival who sees through him. Stand beside the young admiral of Wu as the river fills with fire.

sgc-006.title: Lü Bu
sgc-006.opening: Lü Bu of the Three Kingdoms. The strongest warrior alive trusts no one and is trusted by no one. Ride with him and decide whether a man like that can ever choose a side.

sgc-007.title: Diaochan
sgc-007.opening: Diaochan of the Three Kingdoms. She was given a role in a plot far bigger than herself. Walk the palace corridors with her and see where a chosen path turns into her own.

sgc-008.title: Zhao Yun
sgc-008.opening: Zhao Yun of the Three Kingdoms. One lone rider and a child in his arms against a whole army. Ride beside the steadiest spear of the age and learn what courage looks like when no one is watching.

mortal-path.title: 凡人修仙传 · 谷外微尘
mortal-path.opening: 你是新入黄枫谷的沈微尘。灵根平常，月例微薄，一张能预支灵力的借息契却让你看见捷径。药田断供、试炼失约与撤离名册连在一起：你可以求快，也可以守住同伴，但没有一条路不付代价。

monte-cristo.title: 基督山伯爵 · 余烬与潮汐
monte-cristo.opening: 一封从未入档的信，把档案修复员诺埃尔带到基督山伯爵面前。马赛的旧案与巴黎的财富暗流彼此印证。当证据足以摧毁一个人，你还要查清谁会和他一起倒下。

three-kingdoms.title: 三国演义 · 谋士
three-kingdoms.opening: 化身颍川谋士子衡，从许都走到华容。结交刘备、曹操、关羽、诸葛亮与温芷，让你的话成为承诺，让早先的选择在八章旅程中回响。

three-kingdoms-ink.title: 三国演义 · 谋士（水墨版）
three-kingdoms-ink.opening: 同一个故事的水墨版：画面全部是水墨淡彩。进度与插画版共用。
